annotations.title: List a campaign's recipients and call results

description:
List a campaign's recipients and call results

Returns the numbers in a campaign together with the outcome of each call: status, duration, cost and the identifier of the conversation it produced, where there is one. Rows come back in storage order, which is the order they were supplied in, and the campaign's own state is repeated in `campaignStatus` so a poller does not need a second request. Paging defaults to 50 per page here rather than 20, and `perPage` is clamped to 100. The `pagination` block carries `total`, a count of the recipients stored for this campaign. This operation uses the `read:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

campaignId.description: Identifier of the campaign. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.
